title: 第9章 师徒决裂第10章 无言是最大的轻蔑
slug: 反派神子开局送主角九族消消乐
content_zh:
【叮！
恭喜主人击杀天命女主，天命主角叶不凡气运值减少100点！
【恭喜主人反派值+100！
【叮！
天命主角叶不凡心态爆炸，气运值减少80点！
【恭喜主人反派值+80！
声音宛如悦耳乐章。
姜夜淡淡看向刚刚爬起来的叶不凡，满脸血污，双目赤红，披头散发狼狈极了。
“啊！
啊啊~”
“我要你死！
！”
叶不凡彻底失去理智，眼中满是仇恨和疯狂，一字一句仿佛疯魔般咆哮，就要出手。
李靠背冷汗直冒，猛地冲上台一股气息压在他的身上，使其动弹不得。
“混账东西！”
“你可知你在说些什么？还不快给神子殿下道歉！”
开什么玩笑？
长生仙族姜家，那可是整个诸天万域的无上霸主！
其母红夜女帝，更是诸天万域中，唯一一位没有被邪魔炁气污染过，处于全盛时期的大帝！
二十万年前证道，如今实力更是深不可测，传闻其行事霸道无比，狠毒决绝，灭人九族更是家常便饭，唯一的软肋就是这位神子殿下。

一旦得罪，整个靠山宗怕是连根都不会留下！
叶不凡此刻早就失去理智，不管不顾，疯狂叫嚣道：
“凭什么？我到底错在哪里？凭什么让我道歉？”
“他姜夜不过是仗着背后有长生仙族，才敢这般嚣张跋扈！”
“他不敢与我一战，随意杀人，反倒要我给他道歉？这就是所谓的神子风范？！”
“长生仙族就这般欺压他人，不怕天怒人怨吗？！”
此言一出，全场死寂！
哪怕是姜夜都未开口，场下诸多修士便已面露惊骇之色！
他们还年轻。
可不想因为这个蠢货被害了性命。
众多声音当即响起。
“疯了！
这叶不凡是真的疯了！
！”
“快闭嘴吧你！”
“他这是要拉着我们所有人陪葬啊！
！”
content_en:
【bite!
Congratulations to the master for killing the heroine of Destiny. The fate of the protagonist Ye Bufan has been reduced by 100 points!
[Congratulations to the master for getting the villain value +100!
【bite!
Ye Bufan, the protagonist of Destiny, has an explosive mentality and his luck value is reduced by 80 points!
[Congratulations to the master, the villain value is +80!
The sound is like a sweet piece of music.
Jiang Ye looked faintly at Ye Bufan, who had just gotten up. His face was bloody, his eyes were red, and his hair was disheveled.
"Ah!
Ahh~”
"I want you to die!
! "
Ye Bufan completely lost his mind, his eyes were full of hatred and madness, and he was roaring like a madman every word, and he was about to take action.
Li's back was covered in cold sweat, and he rushed onto the stage. A breath of air pressed on his body, making him unable to move.
"Bastard thing!"
"Do you know what you are talking about? Why don't you apologize to His Highness the Son of God!"
Are you kidding me?
The Jiang family of the Immortal Immortal Clan is the supreme overlord of the entire universe!
His mother, Empress Hongye, was the only emperor in the heyday of the world who had not been contaminated by the energy of evil spirits!
He was enlightened 200,000 years ago, but now his strength is even more unfathomable. It is rumored that he acts extremely domineering and ruthless, and destroying nine tribes is commonplace. His only weakness is His Highness the Son of God.
Once offended, the entire patron sect may not even be able to survive!
Ye Bufan had already lost his mind at this moment. Regardless, he shouted crazily:
"Why? Where did I go wrong? Why should I apologize?"
"Jiang Ye only dares to be so arrogant and domineering because he has the Immortal Clan behind him!"
"He doesn't dare to fight me and kills people at will, but he wants me to apologize to him? Is this the so-called Son of God style?!"
"The Immortal Clan bullies others like this, isn't it afraid of the wrath of heaven and people's resentment?!"
As soon as these words came out, the whole place was completely silent!
Even before Jiang Ye opened his mouth, many monks in the audience had expressions of horror on their faces!
They are still young.
I don’t want to lose my life because of this idiot.
Many voices sounded immediately.
"Crazy!
Ye Bufan is really crazy!
! "
"Shut up, you!"
"He's going to drag us all with him to be buried with him!
! "
